Package org.csystem.util.exception

Class ExceptionUtil

java.lang.Object
org.csystem.util.exception.ExceptionUtil
public final class ExceptionUtil extends Object
Utility class for exception handling operations, including throwing specified types of runtime exceptions and executing actions or suppliers with exception handling and resource management.

  • Method Details

    • doWorkForRunnable

      public static <T extends RuntimeException> void doWorkForRunnable(IAction actionCallback, String msg, Class<T> cls)
      Executes the given action and handles any thrown exceptions by wrapping and rethrowing them as specified exceptions. If an exception is thrown, a new RuntimeException is thrown with the provided message and the original exception as the cause.
      Parameters:
      actionCallback - the IAction action to be executed
      msg - the detail message for the exception if one is thrown
      cls - the class of the exception to be thrown if an exception occurs during the action execution
      Throws:
      T - if an exception occurs during the action execution, and it's rethrown as the specified type

    • doWorkForRunnable

      public static <T extends RuntimeException> void doWorkForRunnable(IAction actionCallback, Consumer<Throwable> consumer, String msg, Class<T> cls)
      Executes the given action and handles any thrown exceptions by wrapping and rethrowing them as specified exceptions. If an exception is thrown, it is passed to the provided consumer and then a new RuntimeException is thrown with the provided message and the original exception as the cause.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the exception that extends RuntimeException
      Parameters:
      actionCallback - the action to be executed
      consumer - the Consumer that processes the exception before it is wrapped and rethrown.
      msg - the detail message for the exception if one is thrown
      cls - the class of the exception to be thrown if an exception occurs during the action execution
      Throws:
      T - if an exception occurs during the action execution, and it's rethrown as the specified type

    • doWorkFor

      public static <T extends RuntimeException, R> R doWorkFor(ISupplier<R> supplier, String msg, Class<T> cls)
      Executes a given supplier function and handles any exceptions thrown during execution.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the runtime exception to be thrown in case of failure. It must extend RuntimeException.
      R - the type of result returned by the supplier.
      Parameters:
      supplier - the ISupplier function to be executed. It must have a method get() that returns a result of type R.
      msg - the message to be included in the exception thrown if an error occurs.
      cls - the class of the RuntimeException to be thrown
      Returns:
      R the result produced by the supplier.
      Throws:
      T - if an exception occurs during the action execution, and it's rethrown as the specified type

    • subscribe

      public static <R> R subscribe(ISupplier<R> supplier, Function<Throwable,R> function)
      Executes a given supplier function and applies a provided function to handle any exceptions thrown during execution.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the type of result returned by both the supplier and the function.
      Parameters:
      supplier - the ISupplier function to be executed. It must have a method get() that returns a result of type R.
      function - the Function that processes the exception if one is thrown. It takes a Throwable as input and returns a result of type R.
      Returns:
      the result produced by the supplier if no exception occurs, or the result produced by the function if an exception is thrown.

    • subscribeRunnable

      public static void subscribeRunnable(IAction actionCallback, Consumer<Throwable> consumer)
      Executes a given action and processes any exceptions thrown during execution with a provided consumer.
      Parameters:
      actionCallback - the IAction callback to be executed. Provide the run() method to execute the action.
      consumer - the Consumer that processes the exception before it is wrapped and rethrown.

    • subscribe

      public static <R> R subscribe(ISupplier<R> supplier, Function<Throwable,R> function, Runnable runnableCompleted)
      Executes a given supplier function, handles any exceptions thrown during execution with a provided function, and always runs a specified runnable upon completion.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the type of result returned by both the supplier and the function.
      Parameters:
      supplier - the ISupplier function to be executed. It must have a method get() that returns a result of type R.
      function - the Function that processes the exception if one is thrown. It takes a Throwable as input and returns a result of type R.
      runnableCompleted - the Runnable that is always executed after the supplier function completes, regardless of whether an exception occurred or not.
      Returns:
      the result produced by the supplier if no exception occurs, or the result produced by the function if an exception is thrown.

    • subscribeRunnable

      public static void subscribeRunnable(IAction actionCallback, Consumer<Throwable> consumer, Runnable runnableCompleted)
      Executes a given action and processes any exceptions thrown during execution with a provided consumer, while always executing a specified runnable upon completion.
      Parameters:
      actionCallback - the IAction callback to be executed. Provide the run() method to execute the action.
      consumer - the Consumer that processes any Throwable that occurs during execution. It accepts the exception and allows for custom handling.
      runnableCompleted - the Runnable that is always executed after the actionCallback completes, regardless of whether an exception occurred or not.

    • subscribe

      public static <R> R subscribe(ISupplier<R> supplier, Closeable closeable, Function<Throwable,R> function, Runnable runnableCompleted)
      Executes a supplier function, handles any exceptions thrown during execution with a provided function, and ensures a closeable resource is managed properly, while always running a specified runnable upon completion.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the type of result returned by both the supplier and the function.
      Parameters:
      supplier - the ISupplier function to be executed. It must have a method get() that returns a result of type R.
      closeable - the Closeable resource that will be automatically closed after the supplier function completes, whether an exception occurs or not.
      function - the Function that processes the exception if one is thrown. It takes a Throwable as input and returns a result of type R.
      runnableCompleted - the Runnable that is always executed after the supplier function completes, regardless of whether an exception occurred or not.
      Returns:
      the result produced by the supplier if no exception occurs, or the result produced by the function if an exception is thrown.

    • subscribeRunnable
